no SSH, no public IP on the nodes
CI writes the image tag and commits
chart shipped via S3 to the cluster
One tested image, from CI to production.
One public entry point, no open SSH.
Every release is a commit; rollback = revert.
GitLab CI and GitHub Actions run the same chain: build images → build the cluster → deploy the pinned version.
